blurb: Guests join charter fishing trips on a Hatteras 41 vessel equipped for offshore fishing. Trips focus on catching striped bass, bluefish, porgies, black sea bass, and other species depending on the season. The captain and professional crew provide guidance and handle boat operations.
extraNote: Final balance due on the boat; cash preferred, all major credit cards accepted · Fish in overcast, light rain or passing showers; reschedule if torrential rain predicted · Captain discretion on fishing due to weather; do not rely on TV weather forecast · Deposit refundable with 2 weeks notice; no shows charged full charter plus gratuity · Dock "F" at Cedar Island Marina; park outside the toll booth gate and arrive 5 minutes prior to departure.
